prompts.tundra:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless terrain texture for 深渊行者. Reference is the approved hand-drawn camp direction; copy its broad quiet hand-painted planes and restrained detail, but use the biome specified below. Flat orthographic TOP DOWN, no isometric preprojection. Edges must match on horizontal and vertical repeat. Entire square canvas opaque and filled; uniform daylight without vignette. Main characters and combat danger marks must remain more visually prominent than this ground. No props, foliage, road, horizon, text, icons, borders, geometric checker grid, realistic grain, noisy microdetails or decorative symbols.
Biome: soft snowy tundra. Broad pale blue-white snow planes with a few muted blue-gray shallow ice patches and small clusters of rounded gray pebbles. Mostly quiet warm-white snow with soft 2-3 value transitions. No sharp crystalline needles, snowflakes, footprints or thick cracks.
